license.note: Procedural metadata and geometry generated by this repository; no external anatomical asset is included.

transforms.scale: orientative only; 1 scene unit is not an anatomical calibration
transforms.orientation: bilateral lateral axis on X; posterior-anterior presentation on Z
transforms.description: Deterministic generator-local coordinates mounted with the overview group transform.

transforms.scale: didactic layer spacing; not calibrated thickness
transforms.orientation: L1 superior to L6 along Y
transforms.description: Local column layout chosen for readable layer and thalamic relationships.

transforms.orientation: four columns by three rows in presentation space
transforms.description: Stable grid positions identify cells without claiming tissue coordinates.
Seed plus cell ID generates presentation-only morphology with a separate geometry hash.
Didactic separation of bouton, cleft and postsynaptic membrane; not ultrastructural measurement.

transforms.scale: illustrative radius and trajectory; no anatomical calibration
transforms.orientation: view-local placement attached to the existing overview, laminar, cell, neuron and synapse roots
transforms.description: The catalog parentId expresses containment only, never flow direction; graph direction lives exclusively in vascular-topology-v1.json.

evidence.claim: Organiza quatro regiões procedurais para orientação macroscópica.
limitations: Não é atlas parcelado.
Não possui escala anatômica calibrada.

evidence.claim: Agrupa os hemisférios procedurais esquerdo e direito.
